title: Static Veil Deacon
text: Static Veil Deacon draws a curtain of white noise around the expedition and listens for panic inside it. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The veil is woven from all the words that fail to arrive.

defeatReward.text: Static Veil Deacon is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
